estimates.assumptions: 1 Knorr Beef Cube is typically 10g based on standard single-serve bouillon cube size.
2 tbs black peppercorns (crushed) estimated at ~6g per tbsp for whole/crushed peppercorns; modest volume for seasoning.
4 dried bay leaves; each ~0.5g, total modest seasoning amount.
Juice from 1/2 lemon (edible portion); ~50g juice yield from half an average lemon (~100-120g whole).
2 tbs tomato sauce/paste ~15g per tbsp, total for the small measured amount in marinade.
